$comment: Interim slicing map for art/reference/panda-sheet-v1.png (Cristian's approved character concept sheet, 1536x1024, flat black background, AI 'fake' pixel art). Boxes are [x, y, w, h] in sheet pixels, measured by flood-filling the background (max RGB channel <= 14) from the borders and taking connected components. Pad each box by 6px before keying. The asset pipeline uses these frames ONLY when art/raw/<id>.png does not exist, so development has a real-looking panda before the final strips arrive. They include baked ground shadows and vary in size; the pipeline must key, trim and bottom-center align them.
unusedRows: attack (potion), hurt, die, special/power-up, directional front/back/left/right, map-icon sizes and extras are not used by the side-scroller; the special/power-up pose is the style reference for panda-celebrate.
